mapper.select: SELECT d.name AS name_label, COUNT(a.id) AS cnt_value FROM sys_appointment a LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON a.dept_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name HAVING cnt_value > 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS name_label, COUNT(id) AS cnt_value FROM sys_appointment WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY name_label
SELECT doc.real_name AS name_label, COUNT(a.id) AS cnt_value FROM sys_appointment a LEFT JOIN sys_doctor doc ON a.doctor_id = doc.id GROUP BY doc.id, doc.real_name ORDER BY cnt_value DESC LIMIT 5
